name: curator_extract_absorbed_into_declarations
notes: Model-declared absorbed_into extraction from skill_manage(delete) tool calls. Harness compiles the REAL C port (src/agent/curator_ports.c) and traces its per-entry result shape (sorted key order); twin imports LIVE agent/curator.py::_extract_absorbed_into_declarations. Out-of-path externals (yaml_*/llm_*/message_*/apply_automatic_transitions) stubbed in harness. Covers: string-JSON args with absorbed_into umbrella/prune-empty, missing absorbed_into, non-delete actions, unrelated tools, object-form arguments, unparseable JSON, non-object/non-string argument types, multi-call ordering (sorted), scalar and null array elements. Inputs with blank/unstripped names or non-string absorbed_into values are excluded: LIVE strips names/targets while the C port does not - a minor documented contract narrowing.
